'''December 2000 Lompoc tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc, California on 9 December 2000. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1519">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-lompoc-12-9-00d1519/ lompoc-12-9-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-lompoc-12-9-00d1519/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Lompoc, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
